caption:
Long rides leaving Toto's back stiff? 🚴

Cycling is brilliant for fitness, but it keeps you folded in one shape for hours. Clinical Pilates works on what the bike doesn't: glutes that share the load with your quads, a mid-back that can extend and rotate, and a trunk that stays steady when your legs are tired.

Start with one or two sessions a week, ideally on an easy spin day rather than the day before a big ride, and build gradually.

Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio starts with an assessment, so your program suits your riding and any niggles. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
